differences.native: LeetCode supplies sortedcontainers.SortedList for membership, ordered iteration, insertion, length, and kth indexing.
differences.app: solve.py defines an explicit local SortedList-compatible ordered set backed by a deterministic treap, then runs the same Accepted solution body.
differences.rationale: The offline app runtime does not bundle the third-party sortedcontainers package. The adapter preserves the exact interface and logarithmic operations; tree traversal, DSU-on-tree merges, query grouping, answers, and complexity match the Accepted algorithm.
